verse.verse_1: WOE TO THOSE who give short measure,
verse.verse_2: Who insist on being given full when they take from others,
verse.verse_3: Whilst when they measure or weigh for them, give less.
verse.verse_4: Do they not think they will be raised (to life) again
verse.verse_6: The day all mankind will stand before the Lord of all the worlds?
verse.verse_7: Indeed the ledger of the wicked will be in (the lowest depths) Sijjin.
verse.verse_8: How will you comprehend what Sijjin is?
verse.verse_9: It is a (repository of) distinctly written record.
verse.verse_10: Ah the woe that day for those who deny,
verse.verse_11: Who call the Day of judgement a lie!
verse.verse_12: None denies it but the sinful transgressors.
verse.verse_13: When Our revelations are recited before him, he says: "These are fables of long ago."
verse.verse_14: No. In fact what they have been doing has rusted their hearts.
verse.verse_15: Therefore they will be screened off from their Lord that day,
verse.verse_16: Then they will indeed burn in Hell.
verse.verse_17: They will then be told: "This is what you had denied."
verse.verse_18: Surely the ledger of the pious will be in 'Illiyun (heights above the heights).
verse.verse_19: But how will you comprehend what 'Illiyun is?
verse.verse_20: It is a (repository of) distinctly written record
verse.verse_21: Witnessed by those who are honoured.
verse.verse_22: Verily the pious will be in heaven,
verse.verse_24: On their faces you will see the glow of beatitude.
verse.verse_25: They will be served the choicest wine, sealed
verse.verse_26: With a sealing of musk, which those who aspire for the best should desire, --
verse.verse_27: Blended with the water of Tasnim, (heights ultimate of evolution),
verse.verse_28: A fountain from which only they who are honoured drink.
verse.verse_29: The sinners indeed laughed at believers
verse.verse_30: And winked at one another as they passed by them;
verse.verse_31: And when they went back to their people turned to make fun of them;
verse.verse_32: And when they saw them, they said: "They have indeed gone astray."
verse.verse_33: But they were not Sent to be guardians over them!
verse.verse_34: So, the believers will laugh at the infidels on that day,
verse.verse_35: Regarding them from their cushioned seats.
verse.verse_36: Will not the infidels pay for what they had done?
